assertions.assertion: The CPT code at issue is 93226.
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The claim for CPT 93226 was denied.
The denial was issued under Reason Code PR-204.
Reason Code PR-204 indicates the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's condition.
The patient has a history of recurrent palpitations.
The palpitations are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia.
Supraventricular tachycardia corresponds to diagnosis code I47.1.
The patient has episodes of dizziness.
Dizziness corresponds to diagnosis code R42.
The patient had a recent event of syncope.
Syncope corresponds to diagnosis code R55.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate the symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management.
